name: Natasha Borgstrom
source:
Natasha "Nat" Borgstrom is the daughter of Sven and Dahlia Borgstrom. Sven owns the local watering hole, named after his loving wife. Nat spends most of her time at the bar saving up for her dream: to travel the world. She grew up in the neighborhood, but [url=/c176650]John[/url]'s boxing took up almost every minute of the day prior to him shipping out. He didn't really get to know her until he returned to the states. Natasha is honest, funny, and loyal.

[Edited from in-game description]
